description: Peoples Dispatch reports hundreds only for the initial La Esperanza station protest. It gives no crowd estimate for the later 8 and 9 February actions, the Choluteca mobilization, or the Tegucigalpa protest; five arrests and four injuries reported cumulatively are not turnout estimates.
required_followup: Find event-specific contemporary attendance evidence for each later gathering and retain the initial La Esperanza estimate only for HND202102E001.

description: The five candidates share a justice demand but differ by date or location. Conexihon plus Peoples Dispatch anchor the La Esperanza actions on 8 and 9 February and Tegucigalpa on 10 February; Choluteca remains undated. The relation between the initial 7 February gathering and later actions, and any national/local coordination, remains a review question.
required_followup: Keep gatherings granular. Review exact dates, organizers and continuity in full linked C-Libre reports and other contemporary reporting before deciding whether any actions represent one event or episode.

description: Conexihon and Peoples Dispatch describe repression, tear gas, rubber bullets, shields and batons and report at least four injuries across the La Esperanza sequence without allocating every action/injury to one date. Choluteca surveillance is reported but not tied to a coded response; Tegucigalpa arrests are specific.
required_followup: Use the linked incident reports to determine event-level attribution. Do not infer firearm shootings from rubber bullets, assign aggregate injuries to individual gatherings, or treat Keyla's prior custody death as protest-period violence.

description: Peoples Dispatch credits a Criterio photograph for its La Esperanza account; this does not establish that its reporting text was syndicated or independent of other local reports. Its count is a single explicit report, not multiple independent confirmations.
required_followup: Check explicit written-source or syndication disclosures before treating the reports as independent; keep the estimate attributed to Peoples Dispatch.

description: 62 additional search-only source cards include possible health-worker/teacher actions, public-employee labor demands, transport and road-access disputes, community protests, and protest-context material. Many may be out of month or duplicate stories; titles alone establish neither an event nor eligibility. Their publication dates, actual occurrence, government target, crowd size, organization, response, and relationship to the five candidates remain unverified. Do not treat missing verification as evidence that no other events occurred.
required_followup: Prioritize the February-dated health, labor, transport and community leads; open exact URLs only after a fresh receipt, complete publisher-origin review and immediate stable-input recheck. Preserve non-occurrences, out-of-month items and exclusions with evidence.

description: HND202102S007 is an El Heraldo photo gallery lead. A first saved gate targeted a guessed Criterio URL, not the source-card URL, and authorized no request. A new exact-URL receipt and full manual review covered 22 El Heraldo-host cards and four review rows, but the immediate complete-input recheck detected changed shared review/source-check and Ireland source inputs. No page body was requested; S007 remains search_only. This is a stale-gate abort, not a denial.
required_followup: If S007 is pursued, obtain a new exact-URL receipt, repeat the full publisher-origin manual review and confirm all input paths and hashes still match immediately before one request.
